title: Encoded Menu
description: Adds a glsl animated homescreen for minecraft!
body:
This pack uses GLSL shaders to make white dots appear moving on the background of minecraft panoramas. This is to make a futuristic internal server code look.

 

By pressing F5, the quality of the shader can be changed (I personally like 20%) but can be done to preference (see gallery)

 

V1: Animated Dots

V2: Matrix Look (Current)

    -V2.1: Compatability with Golden Days Resource Pack

 

REQUIRED TO WORK: GLSL PANORAMA SHADERS MOD
